# Captain's Chest

> Captain's Chest is a home for open-source projects by Nicki Skipper Otte.

## Projects

- [Material Symbols Rounded Icons](https://github.com/captains-chest/material-symbols-rounded-icons): Publishable Angular standalone component libraries for Material Symbols Rounded icons, in outline and filled variants, with a Storybook catalog.
- [Dictator](https://dictator.captains-chest.com): Minimal, local-only dictation for macOS, transcribed on-device.

## More

- [Playground](https://play.captains-chest.com): browser games.
- [School of the Captain's Chest](https://school.captains-chest.com): the agent skills that describe how Captain's Chest codes and works.
